Class FXTrade

java.lang.Object
com.dbtraining.reconx.model.FXTrade
All Implemented Interfaces:
TradeType, Comparable<TradeType>
public final class FXTrade extends Object implements TradeType
============================================================================ TICKET-ADV020 — FXTrade with Builder pattern WHAT: FX spot/forward trade — two currencies, a notional in ccy1, and an fxRate. HOW: Same builder pattern as EquityTrade. notional() converts to ccy2 via fxRate so reconciliation rolls up in the trade's quote ccy. WHY: FX has two natural sides — a EUR/USD trade is BOTH a buy of EUR AND a sell of USD. Modelling that with two distinct currency fields makes settlement-side reasoning explicit. OBSERVE: notional().currency() == ccy2; .amount() == notionalCcy1 * fxRate. ============================================================================
